'''Lapu-Lapu's at-large congressional district''' is the [[congressional districts of the Philippines|congressional district of the Philippines]] in [[Lapu-Lapu City]]. It has been represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] since 2010.<ref name="congleg">{{cite web|title=Roster of Philippine legislators|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province|publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]]|accessdate=March 20, 2020}}</ref> Previously included in [[Cebu's 6th congressional district]], it includes all [[barangay]]s of the city. It is currently represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by [[Junard Chan]] of the [[Partido Federal ng Pilipinas]] (PFP).<ref name="congmem">{{cite web|title=House Members|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/members/|publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]]|accessdate=March 20, 2020}}</ref>
